patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch puts it at the top instead, as older Facebook had it. Another lets it slide away as you scroll, and two more keep the tab bar or the top bar on screen instead. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and one makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, open LIVE panels dark in dark mode, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_added.description: Adds a button to LINE's Font page to use a font file from your device. The page then no longer loads LINE's font list from the server.

patches_added.name: [General] Custom font
patches_added.description: Adds a button to LINE's Font page to use a font file from your device. The page then no longer loads LINE's font list from the server.

patches_added.name: Remove Update Prompt
patches_added.description: Removes byAir's forced-update screen ("Pack up for Update! 🚀" / "Update Now") by pinning its version gate to "no update required". byAir fetches a server-side minimum version code on launch and, if your build is older, blocks the whole app behind a non-dismissible screen whose only action opens Google Play. With the gate closed a patched older build keeps running and never calls the min-version endpoint, so you no longer have to re-patch every time byAir ships a release.

patches_modified.name: Enable Online Pro
patches_modified.description: Experimental companion patch that keeps byAir's online Pro gates open without forcing the crash-prone global entitlement refresh path.

patches_modified.name: Enable Pro
patches_modified.description: Suppresses the main byAir paywall, unlock banners, local user gating, and the notifications preferences "All" gate.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is a local 'is_premium' SharedPreferences flag (in the 'rawcam_prefs' file) read on cold start into a StateFlow. Unlocks RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, custom boosted modes and the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. It also neutralizes PairIP's Play Store licensing (fired from both Application.attachBaseContext and LicenseContentProvider.onCreate, so a repacked copy no longer gets bounced to the Play Store paywall at launch).

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Edge
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_modified.name: Block Ad Server
patches_modified.description: Stops Nepali Patro's ads. Eight byte-asserted edits to libapp.so plus an in-place host rewrite: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length; the interstitial_html dispatch in the ad-queue callback is retargeted so the full-screen page is never pushed; showHtmlInterstitialAdDialog - the single function that raises the HTML interstitial roadblock - is stubbed out; the popup/popup_html branch is forced down the app's own 'blocked' return; and the five raster formats (slider, banner, popup, card_view, circular) are dropped to the build's own empty-widget tail, so the image creatives Remove Ads cannot see - they are fetched by Dart through CachedNetworkImage, not by a WebView - are never requested at all. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to present the shell at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the HTML creatives and the AdMob interstitials.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Nepali Patro's interstitial ads. Two edits to libapp.so: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length, and AdsBloc::featureInterstitialAdWithHtmlPopup - the single callee behind all 24 interstitial call sites - is forced down its existing 'popup blocked' return, so the full-screen ad page and its countdown never open. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to show the page at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the ad content itself and the AdMob interstitials.
